recap: Cavaliers beat the Timberwolves 127–125 in overtime.
Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 26 points (10-21 FG, 5-9 3PT), 5 rebounds and 7 assists.
Anthony Edwards led the Timberwolves with 47 points (19-34 FG, 5-15 3PT), 4 rebounds and 4 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 53.9 to 54.4.
Biggest swing: Anthony Edwards misses 25-foot three point pullup jump shot (OT 3.9), +74 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Allen, Merrill, Tyson, Thomas, +4 in 6:39.
Bench points: CLE 39, MIN 38. Points in the paint: 44–58. Second-chance points: 16–24.
